ResumeProfile.Headline: Software Engineer
ResumeProfile.BaseSummary: Mid-level .NET developer focused on C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, backend integrations and enterprise applications. Familiar with SQL concepts, Entity Framework concepts, Git, Postman, Swagger/OpenAPI, Azure-oriented environments, Docker, Kubernetes, Redis and CI/CD workflows.
